name: Reed-Mother Ossa
role: Aging matriarch and moral center of the Greywater Stilts
voiceHints: Slow, dry, unimpressed by cities and their powers. Runs the talking-circle by saying least and meaning most. Dying and hiding it, because the town has no agreed way to replace her and she fears what the scramble will do.
knowledge: Every fault-line in the Stilts' three factions and which will crack first when she's gone
The true terms of the Heights envoy's offer and the trap folded inside the generosity
The town's founding promise — owe nothing to the aligned powers — and what it has cost to keep
wants: To leave the Stilts able to choose its own next without tearing itself apart — and to do it before her body forces the timeline.
fears: That the independence she gave her life to becomes a bargaining chip the moment she's not there to hold the circle.

reactsToReputation.fair-broker: trusts them with the succession problem
reactsToReputation.self-serving: reads them instantly, freezes them out

appearance: A heavy old woman near eighty, deep brown skin creased fine as cloth, white hair wrapped in faded indigo. Cataract-pale in one eye. Sits with a marsh-reed staff across her knees and rarely stands for anyone.
domainsNote: Derived from this NPC's authored spectrum against the great circle (SNG-174). Kind and domain are independent: a people tends toward positions, an individual holds their own.
_assistWhy: ⛔ CCODE 2026-09-02: 42 of 52 authored people carried NO `assistTags`, so `contributionsOf` fell to its HARM default and 'a master smith counts as a striker'. ✅ TAGS DERIVED FROM THIS PERSON'S OWN AUTHORED `role` AND `knowledge` — nothing invented. ⚠️ HARM IS NOT REMOVED: Erik's rule stands — 'a blacksmith with a spear is a person with a spear.' These tags ADD the families each person was silently missing.
physicality: Near eighty and heavy with it, deep brown skin creased fine as cloth, white hair wrapped in faded blue. Moves slowly and gets where she is going. Hands swollen at the knuckles and still capable. WHAT CATCHES THE EYE: she is the moral centre of the Stilts and everyone in the room orients on her without being told to. That gravity does not switch off.
intimacyNotes: ⚠️ EIGHTY, WIDOWED LONG AGO, AND NOT DONE. A GM should not write her as past wanting — that is the whole point of including her here. ⚠️ SHE HAS BURIED A HUSBAND AND MOST OF HER GENERATION and holds new affection lightly and gratefully, without illusion about how long anything lasts. ⚠️ COMPANIONSHIP IS THE REGISTER, and it is not lesser. CONSENT: asked with great directness and some humour. TONE: warm, unhurried, entirely unembarrassed.
_physWhy: ⚠️ Authored per `po/CONTENT_POLICY_physicality.md`. ⛔ ADULT. The attraction comes OUT of who this person is rather than being applied on top, character bounds hold in intimacy, consent is authored in their own voice, and each entry names something intimacy must NOT resolve.
gear: a reed-cutter's hook and a short axe on the same belt
a staff she does not lean on
_tiered_20260914: ⛑ SNG-590 — TIERED 2026-09-14. The low bands were reported as having no people; they had people and no TIER, so a tier-based filter could not see them. Placed by what the role already says: a child or a stall-holder is riffraff, someone known in one town is notable, a name a whole reach would recognise is regional. ⚠️ These are not lesser characters — they are the cast a level-15 player can meet without meeting somebody who matters to the world.
_vocationWhy: ⛑ SNG-620 — `vocation` and `domains`, the two fields `coverage.mjs` put at 35% and 61%. ⛔ `vocation` is the CLOSED ENUM OF NINE UNIVERSAL ROLES and is how a stranger reads what somebody is FOR. ⚠️ Assigned from each person's own `role` and `assistTags`, never from their tradition: a Mason who tends the dying is an ATTENDANT.

_retiredAxes_20260919._why: ⛔ SNG-633 — TWO AXES RETIRED, AND NOT MAPPED ONTO ANOTHER. `individual_collective` and `tradition_innovation` were authored on 33 records and existed nowhere else: not in `world_node_atlas.axisOrder`, which is TWELVE ORDERED SLOTS and the thing `axisVector` is derived from on every location; not in the GM prompt; and with zero readers in the engine. ⚠️ Erik: 'I don't recall intentionally making these axes — it likely happened along the way. I'm worried about losing coherence.' He was right and I was wrong: I argued to ADD them because they describe real territory, and the twelve is a GEOMETRY rather than a count — a thirteenth means widening a twelve-slot vector on 143 locations and changing a build-time seam. ⛑ AND I DID NOT FOLD THEM INTO A NEIGHBOURING AXIS, because most of these records ALREADY CARRY the nearest candidate with a different authored value — Kestrel's Roost has its own `chaos_order`, and merging would have overwritten a real number with a guess. **The values are preserved below rather than converted, so nothing is lost if they are ever made real.**
